rules.name: xoga713-var-mult-master-vs-legacy
rules.sql: SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult, p.curr_mult_factor, p.lot_mult, p.murex_mult FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table p JOIN dbsystemuat.var_product_code_mapping_table v ON v.invenio_product_code = p.invenio_product_code

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult, p.curr_mult_factor, p.lot_mult, p.murex_mult FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN opera.var_product_code_mapping_table v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.invenio_product_code = p.invenio_product_code WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor AS master_id, s.underlying_id AS price_id_other_case FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN opera.var_product_code_mapping_table v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.invenio_product_code = p.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND lower(s.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.curr_mult_factor IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND x.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor) GROUP BY p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor, s.underlying_id

expect.reason: CM JN and CM CRD gave a different curr_mult than legacy; this shows which master column differs
every curr_mult_factor must exist in underlying_settle_value_table with the same letter case, otherwise the view has no row (CM CRD, EG THE)
